note: Decision scenarios for independent prompt evaluation. Bun checks fixture shape and source contract only, not model or live Orca behavior.

cases.input: Run R published PRs A and B; the same login owns unrelated C. A later verified R publication adds D while watching. B is draft.
cases.expected: Scan A, B, and D on the next pass; exclude C. Draft B stays watched but cannot be merge-ready.

cases.input: A has unchanged head/base but a new failed check attempt, edited review body, and dismissed approval.
cases.expected: Report distinct identities and body digest changes to R; driver observes current state before disposition.

cases.input: One pass is complete and unchanged; the next misses page two of B's comments.
cases.expected: First pass has no wake or notification. Second records incomplete coverage and UNKNOWN readiness, without a false merge-ready claim.

cases.input: A and B each need a repair; A has two feedback items. The observer reports both while the original driver is busy.
cases.expected: Observer dispatches nothing and does not interrupt the busy driver. Driver may assign parallel child worktrees for A and B, with one writer and candidate for both A items.

cases.input: A is a run-created parent of B and gets a new commit; adopted own PR E needs a fix.
cases.expected: Invalidate B evidence and repair lowest ancestor first. Driver publishes/readbacks A before independent authored review; E receives exact-local-SHA independent review before driver gh stack publication/readback.

cases.input: A duplicate report arrives, D closes, then the user cancels while a pass and author Task remain unsettled; disable readback is ambiguous.
cases.expected: Reconcile native identities before duplicate work. Prevent new work, hold stop on ambiguous own-automation disable, and keep worker settlement and archive pending with the driver.
